definitions.gloss: an invention; an invented device or product
definitions.explanation: A new device, machine, or product that someone has invented; the concrete result of an act of invention.

examples.japanese: すばらしい{発明品|はつめいひん}だ。
{電球|でんきゅう}はエジソンの{有名|ゆうめい}な{発明品|はつめいひん}だ。
examples.english: The light bulb is Edison's famous invention.

examples.japanese: この{展示|てんじ}{会|かい}には{学生|がくせい}が{考|かんが}えたユニークな{発明品|はつめいひん}が{並|なら}んでいる。
examples.english: Unique inventions thought up by students are on display at this exhibition.

notes:
Composed of {発明|はつめい} (invention) + the suffix {品|ひん} (article, product). Refers to a concrete invented object, as opposed to the abstract act of inventing.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {新|あたら}しい{発明品|はつめいひん}: a new invention
- {画期的|かっきてき}な{発明品|はつめいひん}: a groundbreaking invention
- {発明品|はつめいひん}を{展示|てんじ}する: to exhibit an invention

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {発明|はつめい}: invention — the act or process of inventing, or the idea itself; {発明品|はつめいひん} is specifically the physical product
